text:
anna-devex: Quick bug report — discrepancy between REST and the JS SDK for the embeddings batch endpoint. Using a query flag to allow partial responses works with curl but the SDK rejects the flag and returns 400.

mike-sdks: can you paste the curl + snippet and SDK version?

anna-devex: SDK v1.8.1. Repro: 
```
# REST
curl -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings?allow_partial=true\" \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \\
  -d '{"model":"tiny-embed","inputs":["a","b","c"]}'
```
And JS: 
```
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.TOKEN });
await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'tiny-embed', inputs: ['a','b','c'], allowPartial: true });
```
REST returns 200 with partial vectors for some inputs; SDK returns 400: \"unknown parameter: allowPartial\".

jess-samples: our quickstart CI started failing when we pushed mixed-length batches 1 — blocks onboarding.

rachel-api: background: the server historically accepted snake_case query keys for compatibility; we also accept camelCase in query parsing for some endpoints. The SDK's request serializer normalizes body keys to snake_case but validates allowed body fields strictly, so allowPartial as an option ends up filtered/dropped and triggers the unknown-parameter error server-side.

mike-sdks: two issues then: param normalization mismatch (query vs body) and different retry behaviors when server signals throttling vs transient errors. Is the intended behavior that SDK should send allow_partial as a query parameter when present?

sam-platform: sample app treats partials as a lower-cost fallback when models are spotty; if SDK blocks with 400 we must split requests which multiplies cost.

mike-sdks: plan: accept camelCase aliases, always emit allow_partial in query for batch endpoints when the flag option is present, and add a CI-level REST vs SDK golden check. Also will add a unit test for param mapping.

anna-devex: another related thing: REST returns \"Retry-After\" header on 429, but SDK was honoring only \"x-retry-after-ms\". We've seen aggressive retries in staging that caused repeated 429s.

rachel-api: we emit both headers for a transition period, but clients should prefer standard Retry-After. If SDK only looks at the vendor header that's a bug.

mike-sdks: I'll change the retry middleware to check Retry-After first, then x-retry-after-ms. Will also add deterministic backoff tests.

deploy-bot: New branch opened: fix/sdk-param-normalization-retry-headers (#2421) by mike-sdks 1 CI triggered.

jess-samples: once that's merged I'll bump the sample quickstart and rerun CI. Could you add a short changelog blurb so users understand camelCase/ snake_case behavior will be more permissive in v1.8.2?

mike-sdks: yes, CHANGELOG will note: \"JS SDK v1.8.2: tolerate camelCase flags, normalize to server query params, and respect HTTP Retry-After header before vendor headers.\"

anna-devex: last ask 1 can we add a tiny smoke test in samples/ci that compares curl vs SDK responses (status + top-level keys) for embeddings and generate? Would catch silent shape drift.

mike-sdks: +1. I'll add a lightweight script to samples/ci that runs both call paths and diffs response shapes.

rachel-api: I'll add coverage on the server side to keep both header names until clients update.

sam-platform: rolling a canary after the patch. Thanks all :tada:
